settings.title: Mobile Logo
settings.description: Shows your forum's logo in the navigation bar on phones, where there is otherwise only a menu button.
settings.source_help: The favicon is usually square, which is the shape that fits a navigation bar. A wide wordmark logo often does not.
settings.custom_url_help: Only used when the setting above is set to a custom image. Best is a path on your own site, such as /assets/my-logo.png, so nothing about your visitors is shared with anyone else. A full address works too, but it must start with https, and hosting the image elsewhere means that host sees every visitor who loads a page. If the address is not usable, no logo is shown rather than a broken image.
settings.position_help: To the left of the menu and back buttons, or to the right of them. Putting it right leaves those buttons against the edge of the screen, which is slightly easier to hit with a thumb.
settings.height_help: How tall the image is in the navigation bar. Between 16 and 64. Default is 32.
settings.link_home_label: Tapping the logo goes to the homepage
settings.link_home_help: Turn this off to show the logo without making it a link.
